functions.name: ImGui_GetBackgroundDrawList
functions.description: This draw list will be the first rendering one. Useful to quickly draw shapes/text behind dear imgui contents.

functions.name: ImGui_GetBuiltinPath
functions.description: Returns the path to the directory containing imgui.lua, imgui.py and gfx2imgui.lua.

functions.name: ImGui_GetColor
functions.description: Retrieve given style color with style alpha applied and optional extra alpha multiplier, packed as a 32-bit value (RGBA). See Col_* for available style colors.

functions.name: ImGui_GetColorEx
functions.description: Retrieve given color with style alpha applied, packed as a 32-bit value (RGBA).

functions.name: ImGui_GetContentRegionAvail
functions.description: Available space from current position. This is your best friend.

functions.name: ImGui_GetCursorPos
functions.description: Cursor position in window-local coordinates.

functions.name: ImGui_GetCursorPosX
functions.description: Cursor X position in window-local coordinates.

functions.name: ImGui_GetCursorPosY
functions.description: Cursor Y position in window-local coordinates.

functions.name: ImGui_GetCursorScreenPos
functions.description: Cursor position in absolute screen coordinates. Prefer using this rather than GetCursorPos (it's also more useful to work with the DrawList API).

functions.name: ImGui_GetCursorStartPos
functions.description: Initial cursor position in window coordinates. Call GetCursorScreenPos after Begin to get the absolute coordinates version.

functions.name: ImGui_GetDeltaTime
functions.description: Time elapsed since last frame, in seconds.

functions.name: ImGui_GetDragDropPayload
functions.description: Peek directly into the current payload from anywhere. Returns false when drag and drop is finished or inactive.

functions.name: ImGui_GetDragDropPayloadFile
functions.description: Get a filename from the list of dropped files. Returns false if index is out of bounds.

functions.name: ImGui_GetFont
functions.description: Get the current font

functions.name: ImGui_GetFontSize
functions.description: Get current font size (= height in pixels) of current font with current scale applied. See also GetTextLineHeight and GetFrameHeight.

functions.name: ImGui_GetForegroundDrawList
functions.description: This draw list will be the last rendered one. Useful to quickly draw shapes/text over dear imgui contents.

functions.name: ImGui_GetFrameCount
functions.description: Get global imgui frame count. incremented by 1 every frame.

functions.name: ImGui_GetFrameHeight
functions.description: GetTextLineHeight + StyleVar_FramePadding.y * 2

functions.name: ImGui_GetFrameHeightWithSpacing
functions.description: GetTextLineHeight + StyleVar_FramePadding.y * 2 + StyleVar_ItemSpacing.y (distance in pixels between 2 consecutive lines of framed widgets).

functions.name: ImGui_GetFramerate
functions.description: Estimate of application framerate (rolling average over 60 frames, based on GetDeltaTime), in frame per second. Solely for convenience.

functions.name: ImGui_GetInputQueueCharacter
functions.description: Read from ImGui's character input queue. Call with increasing idx until false is returned.

functions.name: ImGui_GetItemRectMax
functions.description: Get lower-right bounding rectangle of the last item (screen space)

functions.name: ImGui_GetItemRectMin
functions.description: Get upper-left bounding rectangle of the last item (screen space)

functions.name: ImGui_GetItemRectSize
functions.description: Get size of last item

functions.name: ImGui_GetKeyDownDuration
functions.description: Duration the keyboard key has been down (0.0 == just pressed)

functions.name: ImGui_GetKeyMods
functions.description: Flags for the Ctrl/Shift/Alt/Super keys. Uses Mod_* values.

functions.name: ImGui_GetKeyPressedAmount
functions.description: Uses provided repeat rate/delay. Return a count, most often 0 or 1 but might be >1 if ConfigVar_RepeatRate is small enough that GetDeltaTime > RepeatRate.

functions.name: ImGui_GetMainViewport
functions.description: Returns the viewport associated to REAPER's main window (arrange view).

functions.name: ImGui_GetMouseClickedCount
functions.description: Return the number of successive mouse-clicks at the time where a click happen (otherwise 0).

functions.name: ImGui_GetMouseCursor
functions.description: Get desired mouse cursor shape, reset every frame. This is updated during the frame.

functions.name: ImGui_GetMouseDelta
functions.description: Mouse delta. Note that this is zero if either current or previous position are invalid (-FLT_MAX,-FLT_MAX), so a disappearing/reappearing mouse won't have a huge delta.

functions.name: ImGui_GetMouseDownDuration
functions.description: Duration the mouse button has been down (0.0 == just clicked)

functions.name: ImGui_GetMouseDragDelta
functions.description: Return the delta from the initial clicking position while the mouse button is pressed or was just released. This is locked and return 0.0 until the mouse moves past a distance threshold at least once (uses ConfigVar_MouseDragThreshold if lock_threshold < 0.0).

functions.name: ImGui_GetMousePosOnOpeningCurrentPopup
functions.description: Retrieve mouse position at the time of opening popup we have BeginPopup() into (helper to avoid user backing that value themselves).

functions.name: ImGui_GetMouseWheel
functions.description: Vertical: 1 unit scrolls about 5 lines text. >0 scrolls Up, <0 scrolls Down. Hold SHIFT to turn vertical scroll into horizontal scroll Horizontal: >0 scrolls Left, <0 scrolls Right. Most users don't have a mouse with a horizontal wheel.

functions.name: ImGui_GetScrollMaxX
functions.description: Get maximum scrolling amount ~~ ContentSize.x - WindowSize.x - DecorationsSize.x

functions.name: ImGui_GetScrollMaxY
functions.description: Get maximum scrolling amount ~~ ContentSize.y - WindowSize.y - DecorationsSize.y

functions.name: ImGui_GetScrollX
functions.description: Get scrolling amount [0 .. GetScrollMaxX()]

functions.name: ImGui_GetScrollY
functions.description: Get scrolling amount [0 .. GetScrollMaxY()]

functions.name: ImGui_GetStyleColor
functions.description: Retrieve style color as stored in ImGuiStyle structure. Use to feed back into PushStyleColor, Otherwise use GetColor to get style color with style alpha baked in. See Col_* for available style colors.

functions.name: ImGui_GetTextLineHeight
functions.description: Total height of a line of text (typically higher than GetFontSize depending on the font).

functions.name: ImGui_GetTextLineHeightWithSpacing
functions.description: GetTextLineHeight + StyleVar_ItemSpacing.y (distance in pixels between 2 consecutive lines of text).

functions.name: ImGui_GetTime
functions.description: Get global imgui time. Incremented every frame.

functions.name: ImGui_GetTreeNodeToLabelSpacing
functions.description: Horizontal distance preceding label when using TreeNode*() or Bullet() == (GetFontSize + StyleVar_FramePadding.x*2) for a regular unframed TreeNode.

functions.name: ImGui_GetWindowDpiScale
functions.description: Get DPI scale currently associated to the current window's viewport (1.0 = 96 DPI).

functions.name: ImGui_GetWindowDrawList
functions.description: The draw list associated to the current window, to append your own drawing primitives

functions.name: ImGui_GetWindowHeight
functions.description: Get current window height (shortcut for (GetWindowSize().h). It is unlikely you ever need to use this!

functions.name: ImGui_GetWindowPos
functions.description: Get current window position in screen space. It is unlikely you ever need to use this! Consider always using GetCursorScreenPos and GetContentRegionAvail instead.

functions.name: ImGui_GetWindowSize
functions.description: Get current window size. It is unlikely you ever need to use this! Consider always using GetCursorScreenPos and GetContentRegionAvail instead.

functions.name: ImGui_GetWindowViewport
functions.description: Returns the viewport currently associated to the current window.

functions.name: ImGui_GetWindowWidth
functions.description: Get current window width (shortcut for (GetWindowSize().w). It is unlikely you ever need to use this!

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_AllowWhenBlockedByActiveItem
functions.description: Return true even if an active item is blocking access to this item/window. Useful for Drag and Drop patterns.

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_AllowWhenBlockedByPopup
functions.description: Return true even if a popup window is normally blocking access to this item/window.

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_AllowWhenDisabled
functions.description: Return true even if the item is disabled.

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_AllowWhenOverlapped
functions.description: HoveredFlags_AllowWhenOverlappedByItem | HoveredFlags_AllowWhenOverlappedByWindow

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_AllowWhenOverlappedByItem
functions.description: Return true even if the item uses AllowOverlap mode and is overlapped by another hoverable item.

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_AllowWhenOverlappedByWindow
functions.description: Return true even if the position is obstructed or overlapped by another window.

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_AnyWindow
functions.description: Return true if any window is hovered.

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_ChildWindows
functions.description: Return true if any children of the window is hovered.

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_DelayNone
functions.description: Return true immediately (default). As this is the default you generally ignore this.

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_DelayNormal
functions.description: Return true after ConfigVar_HoverDelayNormal elapsed (~0.40 sec) (shared between items) + requires mouse to be stationary for ConfigVar_HoverStationaryDelay (once per item).

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_DelayShort
functions.description: Return true after ConfigVar_HoverDelayShort elapsed (~0.15 sec) (shared between items) + requires mouse to be stationary for ConfigVar_HoverStationaryDelay (once per item).

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_DockHierarchy
functions.description: Consider docking hierarchy (treat dockspace host as parent of docked window) (when used with _ChildWindows or _RootWindow).

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_ForTooltip
functions.description: Typically used with IsItemHovered() before SetTooltip(). This is a shortcut to pull flags from ConfigVar_HoverFlagsForTooltip* where you can reconfigure the desired behavior. For frequently actioned or hovered items providing a tooltip, you want may to use this (defaults to stationary + delay) so the tooltip doesn't show too often. For items which main purpose is to be hovered, or items with low affordance, or in less consistent apps, prefer no delay or shorter delay.

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_NoNavOverride
functions.description: Disable using keyboard/gamepad navigation state when active, always query mouse.

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_NoPopupHierarchy
functions.description: Do not consider popup hierarchy (do not treat popup emitter as parent of popup) (when used with _ChildWindows or _RootWindow).

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_NoSharedDelay
functions.description: Disable shared delay system where moving from one item to the next keeps the previous timer for a short time (standard for tooltips with long delays

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_None
functions.description: Return true if directly over the item/window, not obstructed by another window, not obstructed by an active popup or modal blocking inputs under them.

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_RectOnly
functions.description: HoveredFlags_AllowWhenBlockedByPopup | HoveredFlags_AllowWhenBlockedByActiveItem | HoveredFlags_AllowWhenOverlapped

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_RootAndChildWindows
functions.description: HoveredFlags_RootWindow | HoveredFlags_ChildWindows

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_RootWindow
functions.description: Test from root window (top most parent of the current hierarchy).

functions.name: ImGui_HoveredFlags_Stationary
functions.description: Require mouse to be stationary for ConfigVar_HoverStationaryDelay (~0.15 sec) _at least one time_. After this, can move on same item/window. Using the stationary test tends to reduces the need for a long delay.

functions.name: ImGui_Image
functions.description: Adds StyleVar_ImageBorderSize on each side.

functions.name: ImGui_ImageButton
functions.description: Draws a background based on regular Button color + optionally an inner background if specified. Adds StyleVar_FramePadding to provided size.

functions.name: ImGui_ImageFlags_NoErrors
functions.description: Return nil instead of returning an error.

functions.name: ImGui_ImageSet_Add
functions.description: 'img' cannot be another ImageSet.

functions.name: ImGui_ImageWithBg
functions.description: Draws a background based on regular Button color + optionally an inner background if specified. Adds StyleVar_FramePadding to provided size.

functions.name: ImGui_Image_GetPixels_Array
functions.description: Read the pixel data of the given rectangle. Pixel format is 0xRRGGBBAAp+0.

functions.name: ImGui_Image_SetPixels_Array
functions.description: Write the pixel data of the given rectangle. Pixel format is 0xRRGGBBAAp+0.

functions.name: ImGui_Indent
functions.description: Move content position toward the right, by 'indent_w', or StyleVar_IndentSpacing if 'indent_w' <= 0. See Unindent.

functions.name: ImGui_InputFlags_Repeat
functions.description: Enable repeat. Return true on successive repeats.

functions.name: ImGui_InputFlags_RouteActive
functions.description: Route to active item only.

functions.name: ImGui_InputFlags_RouteAlways
functions.description: Do not register route, poll keys directly.

functions.name: ImGui_InputFlags_RouteFocused
functions.description: Route to windows in the focus stack. Deep-most focused window takes inputs. Active item takes inputs over deep-most focused window.

functions.name: ImGui_InputFlags_RouteFromRootWindow
functions.description: Option: route evaluated from the point of view of root window rather than current window.

functions.name: ImGui_InputFlags_RouteGlobal
functions.description: Global route (unless a focused window or active item registered the route).

functions.name: ImGui_InputFlags_RouteOverActive
functions.description: Global route: higher priority than active item. Unlikely you need to use that: will interfere with every active items, e.g. Ctrl+A registered by InputText will be overridden by this. May not be fully honored as user/internal code is likely to always assume they can access keys when active.

functions.name: ImGui_InputFlags_RouteOverFocused
functions.description: Global route: higher priority than focused route (unless active item in focused route).

functions.name: ImGui_InputFlags_RouteUnlessBgFocused
functions.description: Option: global route: will not be applied if underlying background/void is focused (== no Dear ImGui windows are focused). Useful for overlay applications.

functions.name: ImGui_InputFlags_Tooltip
functions.description: Automatically display a tooltip when hovering item

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_AllowTabInput
functions.description: Pressing TAB input a '\t' character into the text field.

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_AlwaysOverwrite
functions.description: Overwrite mode.

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_AutoSelectAll
functions.description: Select entire text when first taking mouse focus.

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_CallbackAlways
functions.description: Callback on each iteration. User code may query cursor position, modify text buffer.

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_CallbackCharFilter
functions.description: Callback on character inputs to replace or discard them. Modify 'EventChar' to replace or 'EventChar = 0' to discard.

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_CallbackCompletion
functions.description: Callback on pressing TAB (for completion handling).

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_CallbackEdit
functions.description: Callback on any edit. Note that InputText already returns true on edit + you can always use IsItemEdited. The callback is useful to manipulate the underlying buffer while focus is active.

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_CallbackHistory
functions.description: Callback on pressing Up/Down arrows (for history handling).

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_CharsHexadecimal
functions.description: Allow 0123456789ABCDEFabcdef.

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_CharsNoBlank
functions.description: Filter out spaces, tabs.

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_CharsScientific
functions.description: Allow 0123456789.+-*/eE (Scientific notation input).

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_CharsUppercase
functions.description: Turn a..z into A..Z.

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_CtrlEnterForNewLine
functions.description: In multi-line mode, unfocus with Enter, add new line with Ctrl+Enter (default is opposite: unfocus with Ctrl+Enter, add line with Enter).

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_DisplayEmptyRefVal
functions.description: InputDouble(), InputInt() etc. only: when value is zero, do not display it. Generally used with InputTextFlags_ParseEmptyRefVal.

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_ElideLeft
functions.description: When text doesn't fit, elide left side to ensure right side stays visible. Useful for path/filenames. Single-line only!

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_EnterReturnsTrue
functions.description: Return true when Enter is pressed (as opposed to every time the value was modified). Consider using IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit instead!

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_EscapeClearsAll
functions.description: Escape key clears content if not empty, and deactivate otherwise (constrast to default behavior of Escape to revert).

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_NoHorizontalScroll
functions.description: Disable following the cursor horizontally.

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_NoUndoRedo
functions.description: Disable undo/redo. Note that input text owns the text data while active.

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_ParseEmptyRefVal
functions.description: InputDouble(), InputInt() etc. only: parse empty string as zero value.

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_Password
functions.description: Password mode, display all characters as '*'.

functions.name: ImGui_InputTextFlags_ReadOnly
functions.description: Read-only mode.

functions.name: ImGui_InvisibleButton
functions.description: Flexible button behavior without the visuals, frequently useful to build custom behaviors using the public api (along with IsItemActive, IsItemHovered, etc.).

functions.name: ImGui_IsAnyMouseDown
functions.description: Is any mouse button held?

functions.name: ImGui_IsItemActivated
functions.description: Was the last item just made active (item was previously inactive).

functions.name: ImGui_IsItemActive
functions.description: Is the last item active? (e.g. button being held, text field being edited. This will continuously return true while holding mouse button on an item. Items that don't interact will always return false.

functions.name: ImGui_IsItemClicked
functions.description: Is the last item clicked? (e.g. button/node just clicked on) == IsMouseClicked(mouse_button) && IsItemHovered(). This is NOT equivalent to the behavior of e.g. Button. Most widgets have specific reactions based on mouse-up/down state, mouse position etc.

functions.name: ImGui_IsItemDeactivated
functions.description: Was the last item just made inactive (item was previously active). Useful for Undo/Redo patterns with widgets that require continuous editing.

functions.name: ImGui_IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit
functions.description: Was the last item just made inactive and made a value change when it was active? (e.g. Slider/Drag moved). Useful for Undo/Redo patterns with widgets that require continuous editing. Note that you may get false positives (some widgets such as Combo/ListBox/Selectable will return true even when clicking an already selected item).

functions.name: ImGui_IsItemEdited
functions.description: Did the last item modify its underlying value this frame? or was pressed? This is generally the same as the "bool" return value of many widgets.

functions.name: ImGui_IsItemFocused
functions.description: Is the last item focused for keyboard/gamepad navigation?

functions.name: ImGui_IsItemHovered
functions.description: Is the last item hovered? (and usable, aka not blocked by a popup, etc.). See HoveredFlags_* for more options.

functions.name: ImGui_IsItemToggledOpen
functions.description: Was the last item open state toggled? Set by TreeNode.

functions.name: ImGui_IsItemVisible
functions.description: Is the last item visible? (items may be out of sight because of clipping/scrolling)

functions.name: ImGui_IsKeyChordPressed
functions.description: Was key chord (mods + key) pressed? You can pass e.g. `Mod_Ctrl | Key_S` as a key chord. This doesn't do any routing or focus check, consider using the Shortcut function instead.

functions.name: ImGui_IsKeyDown
functions.description: Is key being held.

functions.name: ImGui_IsKeyPressed
functions.description: Was key pressed (went from !Down to Down)? If repeat=true, uses ConfigVar_KeyRepeatDelay / ConfigVar_KeyRepeatRate.

functions.name: ImGui_IsKeyReleased
functions.description: Was key released (went from Down to !Down)?

functions.name: ImGui_IsMouseClicked
functions.description: Did mouse button clicked? (went from !Down to Down). Same as GetMouseClickedCount() == 1.

functions.name: ImGui_IsMouseDoubleClicked
functions.description: Did mouse button double-clicked? Same as GetMouseClickedCount() == 2. (Note that a double-click will also report IsMouseClicked() == true)

functions.name: ImGui_IsMouseDown
functions.description: Is mouse button held?

functions.name: ImGui_IsMouseDragging
functions.description: Is mouse dragging? (uses ConfigVar_MouseDragThreshold if lock_threshold < 0.0)

functions.name: ImGui_IsMouseHoveringRect
functions.description: Is mouse hovering given bounding rect (in screen space). Clipped by current clipping settings, but disregarding of other consideration of focus/window ordering/popup-block.

functions.name: ImGui_IsMouseReleased
functions.description: Did mouse button released? (went from Down to !Down)

functions.name: ImGui_IsMouseReleasedWithDelay
functions.description: Delayed mouse release (use sparingly!). Generally used with `delay >= ConfigVar_MouseDoubleClickTime` + combined with a `GetMouseClickedCount()==1` test. This is a very rarely used UI idiom, but some apps use this: e.g. MS Explorer single click on an icon to rename.

functions.name: ImGui_IsPopupOpen
functions.description: Return true if the popup is open at the current BeginPopup level of the popup stack. - With PopupFlags_AnyPopupId: return true if any popup is open at the current BeginPopup() level of the popup stack. - With PopupFlags_AnyPopupId + PopupFlags_AnyPopupLevel: return true if any popup is open.

functions.name: ImGui_IsRectVisible
functions.description: Test if rectangle (of given size, starting from cursor position) is visible / not clipped.

functions.name: ImGui_IsRectVisibleEx
functions.description: Test if rectangle (in screen space) is visible / not clipped. to perform coarse clipping on user's side.

functions.name: ImGui_IsWindowAppearing
functions.description: Use after Begin/BeginPopup/BeginPopupModal to tell if a window just opened.

functions.name: ImGui_IsWindowDocked
functions.description: Is current window docked into another window or a REAPER docker?

functions.name: ImGui_IsWindowFocused
functions.description: Is current window focused? or its root/child, depending on flags. See flags for options.

functions.name: ImGui_IsWindowHovered
functions.description: Is current window hovered and hoverable (e.g. not blocked by a popup/modal)? See HoveredFlags_* for options.

functions.name: ImGui_ItemFlags_AllowDuplicateId
functions.description: Allow submitting an item with the same identifier as an item already submitted this frame without triggering a warning tooltip if ConfigVar_ConfigDebugHighlightIdConflicts is set.

functions.name: ImGui_ItemFlags_AutoClosePopups
functions.description: MenuItem/Selectable automatically close their parent popup window. Default = true

functions.name: ImGui_ItemFlags_ButtonRepeat
functions.description: Any button-like behavior will have repeat mode enabled (based on ConfigVar_KeyRepeatDelay and ConfigVar_KeyRepeatRate values). Note that you can also call IsItemActive after any button to tell if it is being held. Default = false

functions.name: ImGui_ItemFlags_NoNav
functions.description: Disable any form of focusing (keyboard/gamepad directional navigation and SetKeyboardFocusHere calls). Default = false

functions.name: ImGui_ItemFlags_NoNavDefaultFocus
functions.description: Disable item being a candidate for default focus (e.g. used by title bar items). Default = false

functions.name: ImGui_ItemFlags_NoTabStop
functions.description: Disable keyboard tabbing. This is a "lighter" version of ItemFlags_NoNav. Default = false.

functions.name: ImGui_Key_AppBack
functions.description: Available on some keyboard/mouses. Often referred as "Browser Back".

functions.name: ImGui_Key_LeftAlt

functions.name: ImGui_ListBox
functions.description: This is an helper over BeginListBox/EndListBox for convenience purpose. Each item must be null-terminated (requires REAPER v6.44 or newer for EEL and Lua).

functions.name: ImGui_ListClipper_Begin
functions.description: - items_count: Use INT_MAX from NumericLimits_Int if you don't know how many items you have (in which case the cursor won't be advanced in the final step, and you can call SeekCursorForItem manually if you need) - items_height: Use -1.0 to be calculated automatically on first step. Otherwise pass in the distance between your items, typically GetTextLineHeightWithSpacing or GetFrameHeightWithSpacing.

functions.name: ImGui_ListClipper_End
functions.description: Automatically called on the last call of ListClipper_Step that returns false.

functions.name: ImGui_ListClipper_IncludeItemByIndex
functions.description: Call ListClipper_IncludeItemByIndex or ListClipper_IncludeItemsByIndex before the first call to ListClipper_Step if you need a range of items to be displayed regardless of visibility. (Due to alignment / padding of certain items it is possible that an extra item may be included on either end of the display range).

functions.name: ImGui_ListClipper_IncludeItemsByIndex
functions.description: See ListClipper_IncludeItemByIndex. item_end is exclusive e.g. use (42, 42+1) to make item 42 never clipped.

functions.name: ImGui_ListClipper_SeekCursorForItem
functions.description: Seek cursor toward given item. This is automatically called while stepping. The only reason to call this is: you can use ListClipper_Begin(INT_MAX) if you don't know item count ahead of time. In this case, after all steps are done, you'll want to call SeekCursorForItem(items_count).

functions.name: ImGui_ListClipper_Step
functions.description: Call until it returns false. The display_start/display_end fields from ListClipper_GetDisplayRange will be set and you can process/draw those items.

functions.name: ImGui_LogFinish
functions.description: Stop logging (close file, etc.)

functions.name: ImGui_LogText
functions.description: Pass text data straight to log (without being displayed)

functions.name: ImGui_LogToClipboard
functions.description: Start logging all text output from the interface to the OS clipboard. See also SetClipboardText.

functions.name: ImGui_LogToFile
functions.description: Start logging all text output from the interface to a file. The data is saved to $resource_path/imgui_log.txt if filename is nil.

functions.name: ImGui_LogToTTY
functions.description: Start logging all text output from the interface to the TTY (stdout).

functions.name: ImGui_MenuItem
functions.description: Return true when activated. Shortcuts are displayed for convenience but not processed by ImGui at the moment. Toggle state is written to 'selected' when provided.

functions.name: ImGui_Mod_Ctrl

functions.name: ImGui_Mod_Super

functions.name: ImGui_MouseCursor_Progress

functions.name: ImGui_MouseCursor_ResizeAll
functions.description: (Unused by Dear ImGui functions)

functions.name: ImGui_MouseCursor_ResizeNESW

functions.name: ImGui_MouseCursor_ResizeNS

functions.name: ImGui_MouseCursor_ResizeNWSE

functions.name: ImGui_MouseCursor_Wait

functions.description: Returns DBL_MIN and DBL_MAX for this system.

functions.description: Returns INT_MIN and INT_MAX for this system.

functions.name: ImGui_OpenPopup
functions.description: Set popup state to open (don't call every frame!). ImGuiPopupFlags are available for opening options. If not modal: they can be closed by clicking anywhere outside them, or by pressing ESCAPE. Use PopupFlags_NoOpenOverExistingPopup to avoid opening a popup if there's already one at the same level.

functions.name: ImGui_OpenPopupOnItemClick
functions.description: Helper to open popup when clicked on last item. return true when just opened. (Note: actually triggers on the mouse _released_ event to be consistent with popup behaviors.)

functions.name: ImGui_PointConvertNative
functions.description: Convert a position from the current platform's native coordinate position system to ReaImGui global coordinates (or vice versa). This effectively flips the Y coordinate on macOS and applies HiDPI scaling on Windows and Linux.

functions.name: ImGui_PopClipRect
functions.description: See PushClipRect

functions.name: ImGui_PopFont
functions.description: See PushFont.

functions.name: ImGui_PopID
functions.description: Pop from the ID stack.

functions.name: ImGui_PopItemFlag
functions.description: See PushItemFlag

functions.name: ImGui_PopItemWidth
functions.description: See PushItemWidth

functions.name: ImGui_PopStyleVar
functions.description: Reset a style variable.

functions.name: ImGui_PopupFlags_AnyPopup
functions.description: PopupFlags_AnyPopupId | PopupFlags_AnyPopupLevel

functions.name: ImGui_PopupFlags_AnyPopupId
functions.description: Ignore the str_id parameter and test for any popup.

functions.name: ImGui_PopupFlags_AnyPopupLevel
functions.description: Search/test at any level of the popup stack (default test in the current level).

functions.name: ImGui_PopupFlags_MouseButtonLeft
functions.description: Open on Left Mouse release. Guaranteed to always be == 0 (same as MouseButton_Left).

functions.name: ImGui_PopupFlags_MouseButtonMiddle
functions.description: Open on Middle Mouse release. Guaranteed to always be == 2 (same as MouseButton_Middle).

functions.name: ImGui_PopupFlags_MouseButtonRight
functions.description: Open on Right Mouse release. Guaranteed to always be == 1 (same as MouseButton_Right).

functions.name: ImGui_PopupFlags_NoOpenOverExistingPopup
functions.description: Don't open if there's already a popup at the same level of the popup stack.

functions.name: ImGui_PopupFlags_NoOpenOverItems
functions.description: For BeginPopupContextWindow: don't return true when hovering items, only when hovering empty space.

functions.name: ImGui_PopupFlags_NoReopen
functions.description: Don't reopen same popup if already open (won't reposition, won't reinitialize navigation).

functions.name: ImGui_ProgressBar
functions.description: Fraction < 0.0 displays an indeterminate progress bar animation since v0.9.1. The value must be animated along with time, for example `-1.0 * ImGui.GetTime()`.

functions.name: ImGui_PushFont
functions.description: Change the current font. Pass font=nil to only change the size. See PopFont.

functions.name: ImGui_PushID
functions.description: Push string into the ID stack.

functions.name: ImGui_PushItemFlag
functions.description: Modify specified shared item flag for certain widgets. Example: `PushItemFlag(ItemFlags_NoTabStop, true)`.

functions.name: ImGui_PushItemWidth
functions.description: Push width of items for common large "item+label" widgets. - \>0.0: width in pixels - <0.0 align xx pixels to the right of window (so -FLT_MIN always align width to the right side) - 0.0 = default to ~2/3 of windows width.

functions.name: ImGui_PushStyleColor
functions.description: Temporarily modify a style color. Call PopStyleColor to undo after use (before the end of the frame). See Col_* for available style colors.

functions.name: ImGui_PushStyleVar
functions.description: Temporarily modify a style variable. Call PopStyleVar to undo after use (before the end of the frame). See StyleVar_* for possible values of 'idx'.

functions.name: ImGui_PushStyleVarX
functions.description: Modify the X component of a style variable. See PushStyleVar.

functions.name: ImGui_PushStyleVarY
functions.description: Modify the X component of a style variable. See PushStyleVar.

functions.name: ImGui_PushTextWrapPos
functions.description: Push word-wrapping position for Text*() commands. - < 0.0: no wrapping - = 0.0: wrap to end of window (or column) - \> 0.0: wrap at 'wrap_pos_x' position in window local space.

functions.name: ImGui_RadioButton
functions.description: Use with e.g. if (RadioButton("one", my_value==1)) { my_value = 1; }

functions.name: ImGui_RadioButtonEx
functions.description: Shortcut to handle RadioButton's example pattern when value is an integer

functions.name: ImGui_SameLine
functions.description: Call between widgets or groups to layout them horizontally. X position given in window coordinates.

functions.name: ImGui_SelectableFlags_AllowDoubleClick
functions.description: Generate press events on double clicks too.

functions.name: ImGui_SelectableFlags_AllowOverlap
functions.description: Hit testing to allow subsequent widgets to overlap this one.

functions.name: ImGui_SelectableFlags_Disabled
functions.description: Cannot be selected, display grayed out text.

functions.name: ImGui_SelectableFlags_Highlight
functions.description: Make the item be displayed as if it is hovered.

functions.name: ImGui_SelectableFlags_NoAutoClosePopups
functions.description: Clicking this doesn't close parent popup window (overrides ItemFlags_AutoClosePopups)

functions.name: ImGui_SelectableFlags_SpanAllColumns
functions.description: Frame will span all columns of its container table (text will still fit in current column).

functions.name: ImGui_Separator
functions.description: Separator, generally horizontal. inside a menu bar or in horizontal layout mode, this becomes a vertical separator.

functions.name: ImGui_SeparatorText
functions.description: Text formatted with an horizontal line

functions.name: ImGui_SetClipboardText
functions.description: See also the LogToClipboard function to capture GUI into clipboard, or easily output text data to the clipboard.

functions.name: ImGui_SetColorEditOptions
functions.description: Picker type, etc. User will be able to change many settings, unless you pass the _NoOptions flag to your calls.

functions.name: ImGui_SetCursorPos
functions.description: Cursor position in window

functions.name: ImGui_SetCursorPosX
functions.description: Cursor X position in window

functions.name: ImGui_SetCursorPosY
functions.description: Cursor Y position in window

functions.name: ImGui_SetCursorScreenPos
functions.description: Cursor position in absolute screen coordinates.

functions.name: ImGui_SetDragDropPayload
functions.description: The type is a user defined string of maximum 32 characters. Strings starting with '_' are reserved for dear imgui internal types. Data is copied and held by imgui.

functions.name: ImGui_SetItemDefaultFocus
functions.description: Make last item the default focused item of a newly appearing window.

functions.name: ImGui_SetItemTooltip
functions.description: Set a text-only tooltip if preceding item was hovered. Override any previous call to SetTooltip(). Shortcut for `if (IsItemHovered(HoveredFlags_ForTooltip)) { SetTooltip(...); }`.

functions.name: ImGui_SetKeyboardFocusHere
functions.description: Focus keyboard on the next widget. Use positive 'offset' to access sub components of a multiple component widget. Use -1 to access previous widget.

functions.name: ImGui_SetMouseCursor
functions.description: Set desired mouse cursor shape. See MouseCursor_* for possible values.

functions.name: ImGui_SetNavCursorVisible
functions.description: Alter visibility of keyboard/gamepad cursor. By default: shown when using an arrow key, hidden when clicking with the mouse.

functions.name: ImGui_SetNextFrameWantCaptureKeyboard
functions.description: Request capture of keyboard shortcuts in REAPER's global scope for the next frame.

functions.name: ImGui_SetNextItemAllowOverlap
functions.description: Allow next item to be overlapped by a subsequent item. Useful with invisible buttons, selectable, treenode covering an area where subsequent items may need to be added. Note that both Selectable() and TreeNode() have dedicated flags doing this.

functions.name: ImGui_SetNextItemOpen
functions.description: Set next TreeNode/CollapsingHeader open state. Can also be done with the TreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen flag.

functions.name: ImGui_SetNextItemWidth
functions.description: Set width of the _next_ common large "item+label" widget. - \>0.0: width in pixels - <0.0 align xx pixels to the right of window (so -FLT_MIN always align width to the right side)

functions.name: ImGui_SetNextWindowBgAlpha
functions.description: Set next window background color alpha. Helper to easily override the Alpha component of Col_WindowBg/Col_ChildBg/Col_PopupBg. You may also use WindowFlags_NoBackground for a fully transparent window.

functions.name: ImGui_SetNextWindowCollapsed
functions.description: Set next window collapsed state.

functions.name: ImGui_SetNextWindowContentSize
functions.description: Set next window content size (~ scrollable client area, which enforce the range of scrollbars). Not including window decorations (title bar, menu bar, etc.) nor StyleVar_WindowPadding. set an axis to 0.0 to leave it automatic.

functions.name: ImGui_SetNextWindowFocus
functions.description: Set next window to be focused / top-most.

functions.name: ImGui_SetNextWindowPos
functions.description: Set next window position. Use pivot=(0.5,0.5) to center on given point, etc.

functions.name: ImGui_SetNextWindowScroll
functions.description: Set next window scrolling value (use < 0.0 to not affect a given axis).

functions.name: ImGui_SetNextWindowSize
functions.description: Set next window size. set axis to 0.0 to force an auto-fit on this axis.

functions.name: ImGui_SetNextWindowSizeConstraints
functions.description: Set next window size limits. Use 0.0 or FLT_MAX (second return value of NumericLimits_Float) if you don't want limits. Use -1 for both min and max of same axis to preserve current size (which itself is a constraint). Use callback to apply non-trivial programmatic constraints.

functions.name: ImGui_SetScrollFromPosX
functions.description: Adjust scrolling amount to make given position visible. Generally GetCursorStartPos() + offset to compute a valid position.

functions.name: ImGui_SetScrollFromPosY
functions.description: Adjust scrolling amount to make given position visible. Generally GetCursorStartPos() + offset to compute a valid position.

functions.name: ImGui_SetScrollHereX
functions.description: Adjust scrolling amount to make current cursor position visible. center_x_ratio=0.0: left, 0.5: center, 1.0: right. When using to make a "default/current item" visible, consider using SetItemDefaultFocus instead.

functions.name: ImGui_SetScrollHereY
functions.description: Adjust scrolling amount to make current cursor position visible. center_y_ratio=0.0: top, 0.5: center, 1.0: bottom. When using to make a "default/current item" visible, consider using SetItemDefaultFocus instead.

functions.name: ImGui_SetScrollX
functions.description: Set scrolling amount [0 .. GetScrollMaxX()]

functions.name: ImGui_SetScrollY
functions.description: Set scrolling amount [0 .. GetScrollMaxY()]

functions.name: ImGui_SetTabItemClosed
functions.description: Notify TabBar or Docking system of a closed tab/window ahead (useful to reduce visual flicker on reorderable tab bars). For tab-bar: call after BeginTabBar and before Tab submissions. Otherwise call with a window name.

functions.name: ImGui_SetTooltip
functions.description: Set a text-only tooltip. Often used after a IsItemHovered() check. Override any previous call to SetTooltip. Shortcut for `if (BeginTooltip()) { Text(...); EndTooltip(); }`.

functions.name: ImGui_SetWindowCollapsed
functions.description: (Not recommended) Set current window collapsed state. Prefer using SetNextWindowCollapsed.

functions.name: ImGui_SetWindowCollapsedEx
functions.description: Set named window collapsed state.

functions.name: ImGui_SetWindowFocus
functions.description: (Not recommended) Set current window to be focused / top-most. Prefer using SetNextWindowFocus.

functions.name: ImGui_SetWindowFocusEx
functions.description: Set named window to be focused / top-most. Use an empty name to remove focus.

functions.name: ImGui_SetWindowPos
functions.description: (Not recommended) Set current window position - call within Begin/End. Prefer using SetNextWindowPos, as this may incur tearing and minor side-effects.

functions.name: ImGui_SetWindowPosEx
functions.description: Set named window position.

functions.name: ImGui_SetWindowSize
functions.description: (Not recommended) Set current window size - call within Begin/End. Set size_w and size_h to 0 to force an auto-fit. Prefer using SetNextWindowSize, as this may incur tearing and minor side-effects.

functions.name: ImGui_SetWindowSizeEx
functions.description: Set named window size. Set axis to 0.0 to force an auto-fit on this axis.

functions.name: ImGui_ShowAboutWindow
functions.description: Create About window. Display ReaImGui version, Dear ImGui version, credits and build/system information.

functions.name: ImGui_ShowDebugLogWindow
functions.description: Create Debug Log window. display a simplified log of important dear imgui events.

functions.name: ImGui_ShowIDStackToolWindow
functions.description: Create Stack Tool window. Hover items with mouse to query information about the source of their unique ID.

functions.name: ImGui_ShowMetricsWindow
functions.description: Create Metrics/Debugger window. Display Dear ImGui internals: windows, draw commands, various internal state, etc.

functions.name: ImGui_SliderFlags_AlwaysClamp
functions.description: SliderFlags_ClampOnInput | SliderFlags_ClampZeroRange

functions.name: ImGui_SliderFlags_ClampOnInput
functions.description: Clamp value to min/max bounds when input manually with Ctrl+Click. By default Ctrl+Click allows going out of bounds.

functions.name: ImGui_SliderFlags_ClampZeroRange
functions.description: Clamp even if min==max==0. Otherwise due to legacy reason Drag* functions don't clamp with those values. When your clamping limits are dynamic you almost always want to use it.

functions.name: ImGui_SliderFlags_Logarithmic
functions.description: Make the widget logarithmic (linear otherwise). Consider using SliderFlags_NoRoundToFormat with this if using a format-string with small amount of digits.

functions.name: ImGui_SliderFlags_NoInput
functions.description: Disable CTRL+Click or Enter key allowing to input text directly into the widget.

functions.name: ImGui_SliderFlags_NoRoundToFormat
functions.description: Disable rounding underlying value to match precision of the display format string (e.g. %.3f values are rounded to those 3 digits).

functions.name: ImGui_SliderFlags_NoSpeedTweaks
functions.description: Disable keyboard modifiers altering tweak speed. Useful if you want to alter tweak speed yourself based on your own logic.

functions.name: ImGui_SliderFlags_WrapAround
functions.description: Enable wrapping around from max to min and from min to max. Only supported by Drag* functions for now.

functions.name: ImGui_SmallButton
functions.description: Button with StyleVar_FramePadding.y == 0 to easily embed within text.

functions.name: ImGui_SortDirection_Ascending
functions.description: Ascending = 0->9, A->Z etc.

functions.name: ImGui_SortDirection_Descending
functions.description: Descending = 9->0, Z->A etc.

functions.name: ImGui_Spacing
functions.description: Add vertical spacing.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_Alpha
functions.description: Global alpha applies to everything in Dear ImGui.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_ButtonTextAlign
functions.description: Alignment of button text when button is larger than text. Defaults to (0.5, 0.5) (centered).

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_CellPadding
functions.description: Padding within a table cell. CellPadding.x is locked for entire table. CellPadding.y may be altered between different rows.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_ChildBorderSize
functions.description: Thickness of border around child windows. Generally set to 0.0 or 1.0. (Other values are not well tested and more CPU/GPU costly).

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_ChildRounding
functions.description: Radius of child window corners rounding. Set to 0.0 to have rectangular windows.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_DisabledAlpha
functions.description: Additional alpha multiplier applied by BeginDisabled. Multiply over current value of Alpha.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_FrameBorderSize
functions.description: Thickness of border around frames. Generally set to 0.0 or 1.0. (Other values are not well tested and more CPU/GPU costly).

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_FramePadding
functions.description: Padding within a framed rectangle (used by most widgets).

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_FrameRounding
functions.description: Radius of frame corners rounding. Set to 0.0 to have rectangular frame (used by most widgets).

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_GrabMinSize
functions.description: Minimum width/height of a grab box for slider/scrollbar.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_GrabRounding
functions.description: Radius of grabs corners rounding. Set to 0.0 to have rectangular slider grabs.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_ImageBorderSize
functions.description: Thickness of border around Image calls.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_IndentSpacing
functions.description: Horizontal indentation when e.g. entering a tree node. Generally == (GetFontSize + StyleVar_FramePadding.x*2).

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_ItemInnerSpacing
functions.description: Horizontal and vertical spacing between within elements of a composed widget (e.g. a slider and its label).

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_ItemSpacing
functions.description: Horizontal and vertical spacing between widgets/lines.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_PopupBorderSize
functions.description: Thickness of border around popup/tooltip windows. Generally set to 0.0 or 1.0. (Other values are not well tested and more CPU/GPU costly).

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_PopupRounding
functions.description: Radius of popup window corners rounding. (Note that tooltip windows use StyleVar_WindowRounding.)

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_ScrollbarRounding
functions.description: Radius of grab corners for scrollbar.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_ScrollbarSize
functions.description: Width of the vertical scrollbar, Height of the horizontal scrollbar.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_SelectableTextAlign
functions.description: Alignment of selectable text. Defaults to (0.0, 0.0) (top-left aligned). It's generally important to keep this left-aligned if you want to lay multiple items on a same line.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_SeparatorTextAlign
functions.description: Alignment of text within the separator. Defaults to (0.0, 0.5) (left aligned, center).

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_SeparatorTextBorderSize
functions.description: Thickness of border in SeparatorText()

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_SeparatorTextPadding
functions.description: Horizontal offset of text from each edge of the separator + spacing on other axis. Generally small values. .y is recommended to be == StyleVar_FramePadding.y.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_TabBarBorderSize
functions.description: Thickness of tab-bar separator, which takes on the tab active color to denote focus.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_TabBarOverlineSize
functions.description: Thickness of tab-bar overline, which highlights the selected tab-bar.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_TabBorderSize
functions.description: Thickness of border around tabs.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_TabRounding
functions.description: Radius of upper corners of a tab. Set to 0.0 to have rectangular tabs.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_TableAngledHeadersAngle
functions.description: Angle of angled headers (supported values range from -50.0 degrees to +50.0 degrees).

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_TableAngledHeadersTextAlign
functions.description: Alignment of angled headers within the cell

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_TreeLinesRounding
functions.description: Radius of lines connecting child nodes to the vertical line.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_TreeLinesSize
functions.description: Thickness of outlines when using TreeNodeFlags_DrawLines.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_WindowBorderSize
functions.description: Thickness of border around windows. Generally set to 0.0 or 1.0. (Other values are not well tested and more CPU/GPU costly).

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_WindowMinSize
functions.description: Minimum window size. This is a global setting. If you want to constrain individual windows, use SetNextWindowSizeConstraints.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_WindowPadding
functions.description: Padding within a window.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_WindowRounding
functions.description: Radius of window corners rounding. Set to 0.0 to have rectangular windows. Large values tend to lead to variety of artifacts and are not recommended.

functions.name: ImGui_StyleVar_WindowTitleAlign
functions.description: Alignment for title bar text. Defaults to (0.0,0.5) for left-aligned,vertically centered.

functions.name: ImGui_TabBarFlags_AutoSelectNewTabs

functions.name: ImGui_TabBarFlags_DrawSelectedOverline
functions.description: Draw selected overline markers over selected tab

functions.name: ImGui_TabBarFlags_FittingPolicyResizeDown
functions.description: Resize tabs when they don't fit.

functions.name: ImGui_TabBarFlags_FittingPolicyScroll
functions.description: Add scroll buttons when tabs don't fit.

functions.name: ImGui_TabBarFlags_NoCloseWithMiddleMouseButton

functions.name: ImGui_TabBarFlags_NoTabListScrollingButtons
functions.description: Disable scrolling buttons (apply when fitting policy is TabBarFlags_FittingPolicyScroll).

functions.name: ImGui_TabBarFlags_NoTooltip
functions.description: Disable tooltips when hovering a tab.

functions.name: ImGui_TabBarFlags_Reorderable

functions.name: ImGui_TabBarFlags_TabListPopupButton

functions.name: ImGui_TabItemButton

functions.name: ImGui_TabItemFlags_Leading

functions.name: ImGui_TabItemFlags_NoCloseWithMiddleMouseButton
functions.description: Disable behavior of closing tabs (that are submitted with p_open != nil) with middle mouse button. You can still repro this behavior on user's side with if(IsItemHovered() && IsMouseClicked(2)) p_open = false.

functions.name: ImGui_TabItemFlags_NoPushId
functions.description: Don't call PushID()/PopID() on BeginTabItem/EndTabItem.

functions.name: ImGui_TabItemFlags_NoReorder
functions.description: Disable reordering this tab or having another tab cross over this tab.

functions.name: ImGui_TabItemFlags_NoTooltip
functions.description: Disable tooltip for the given tab.

functions.name: ImGui_TabItemFlags_SetSelected
functions.description: Trigger flag to programmatically make the tab selected when calling BeginTabItem.

functions.name: ImGui_TabItemFlags_Trailing
functions.description: Enforce the tab position to the right of the tab bar (before the scrolling buttons).

functions.name: ImGui_TabItemFlags_UnsavedDocument
functions.description: Display a dot next to the title + set TabItemFlags_NoAssumedClosure.

functions.name: ImGui_TableAngledHeadersRow
functions.description: Submit a row with angled headers for every column with the TableColumnFlags_AngledHeader flag. Must be the first row.

functions.name: ImGui_TableBgTarget_CellBg

functions.name: ImGui_TableBgTarget_RowBg0
functions.description: Set row background color 0 (generally used for background, automatically set when TableFlags_RowBg is used).

functions.name: ImGui_TableBgTarget_RowBg1

functions.name: JS_Composite
functions.description: Composites a LICE bitmap with a REAPER window. Each time that the window is re-drawn, the bitmap will be blitted over the window's client area (with per-pixel alpha blending). * If dstw or dsth is -1, the bitmap will be stretched to fill the width or height of the window, respectively. * autoUpdate is an optional parameter that is false by default. If true, JS_Composite will automatically invalidate and re-draw the part of the window that covers the current position of the bitmap, and if the bitmap is being moved, also the previous position. (If only one or a handful of bitmaps are being moved across the screen, autoUpdate should result in smoother animation on WindowsOS; if numerous bitmaps are spread over the entire window, it may be faster to disable autoUpdate and instead call JS_Window_InvalidateRect explicitly once all bitmaps have been moved.) * InvalidateRect should also be called whenever the contents of the bitmap contents have been changed, but not the position, to trigger a window update. * On WindowsOS, the key to reducing flickering is to slow down the frequency at which the window is re-drawn. InvalidateRect should only be called when absolutely necessary, preferably not more than 20 times per second. (Also refer to the JS_Composite_Delay function.) * On WindowsOS, flickering can further be reduced by keeping the invalidated area as small as possible, covering only the bitmaps that have been edited or moved. However, if numerous bitmaps are spread over the entire window, it may be faster to simply invalidate the entire client area. * This function should not be applied directly to top-level windows, but rather to child windows. * Some classes of UI elements, particularly buttons, do not take kindly to being composited, and may crash REAPER. * On WindowsOS, GDI blitting does not perform alpha multiplication of the source bitmap. For proper color rendering, a separate pre-multiplication step is therefore required, using either LICE_Blit or LICE_ProcessRect. Returns: 1 if successful, otherwise -1 = windowHWND is not a window, -3 = Could not obtain the original window process, -4 = sysBitmap is not a LICE bitmap, -5 = sysBitmap is not a system bitmap, -6 = Could not obtain the window HDC, -7 = Error when subclassing to new window process.

functions.name: JS_Composite_Delay
functions.description: On WindowsOS, flickering of composited images can be improved considerably by slowing the refresh rate of the window. The optimal refresh rate may depend on the number of composited bitmaps. minTime is the minimum refresh delay, in seconds, when only one bitmap is composited onto the window. The delay time will increase linearly with the number of bitmaps, up to a maximum of maxTime when numBitmapsWhenMax is reached. If both minTime and maxTime are 0, all delay settings for the window are cleared. Returns: * retval = 1 if successful, 0 if arguments are invalid (i.e. if maxTime < minTime, or maxBitmaps < 1). * If delay times have not previously been set for this window, prev time values are 0.

functions.name: JS_Composite_ListBitmaps
functions.description: Returns all bitmaps composited to the given window. The list is formatted as a comma-separated string of hexadecimal values, each representing a LICE_IBitmap* pointer. retval is the number of linked bitmaps found, or negative if an error occured.

functions.name: JS_Composite_Unlink
functions.description: Unlinks the window and bitmap. * autoUpdate is an optional parameter. If unlinking a single bitmap and autoUpdate is true, the function will automatically re-draw the window to remove the blitted image. If no bitmap is specified, all bitmaps composited to the window will be unlinked -- even those by other scripts.
